cards.title: What is Scraping?
items: Scraping is the automated extraction of raw job data from 32+ corporate career boards (Amazon, Greenhouse, Workday, Phenom, SmartRecruiters)
Transforms unstructured webpage HTML and JSON API payloads into standardized job records (Title, Company, Location, Job URL, Description)
Runs on an automated schedule (every 3 hours) in GitHub Actions without manual intervention

cards.title: Deduplication & Keyword Guard
items: Deduplication: Compares newly scraped job IDs against scraped_jobs.json (44MB local database) so previously seen jobs are ignored
Keyword Filtering: Filters titles (Analyst, Data, Science, Product, Lead) before calling Gemini API to conserve API quota

cards.title: AI Evaluation & Card Delivery
items: Gemini LLM scores each job description against candidate resume parameters (0-100 score + 2-5 word requirement tags)
High-scoring opportunities (Score >= 70) trigger SMTP delivery of formatted vertical card emails with 1-click apply buttons
